entries.title: Larger frozen backbone
entries.issue: E3 regressed against E2 and retained task collapse.
entries.hypothesis: A frozen 27B backbone may transfer better than 9B with the same head recipe.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Replace only the frozen backbone and extract fresh inputs; retain the matched recipe. A larger backbone is a proposed remedy, not an established cause of the regressions.
entries.outcome: Accuracy-selected fallback E4: 60.9322% composite. Optimized-runtime E4: 61.2611%. Historical E3: 59.8528%; that historical contrast also changes selection/runtime.

entries.title: Remove the full attention causal mask
entries.issue: A causal backbone can limit interactions among evidence, question and options.
entries.hypothesis: Bidirectional full-attention layers improve evidence binding.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Remove causality only in full-attention blocks; recurrent and convolution paths remain causal.
entries.outcome: Completed: 68.4141% versus matched native 61.2611%, +7.1530 pp. Circa and RAGTruth regress. Single seed; broad causal/seed robustness remains unconfirmed.

entries.title: Checkpoint selection by accuracy
entries.issue: The original selection used dev NLL despite an accuracy-based objective.
entries.hypothesis: Selecting maximum dev accuracy better matches the graded objective.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Use dev accuracy and earliest-epoch ties. Recover saved E4 epoch 5 without retraining; fit temperature separately on calibration.
entries.outcome: Implemented and tested. Original NLL-selected results retained as historical; no selection by NLL going forward.

entries.title: RuleTaker add-back
entries.issue: Boolean entailment and negation transfer remain weak.
entries.hypothesis: Explicit rule supervision may restore supported/unsupported distinctions.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Add 250 native-labelled RuleTaker decisions with normalized requests.
entries.outcome: 60.9343%, +0.0062 pp versus 60.9281% equal-volume control; no demonstrated gain; TabFact declines 2.5 pp.

entries.title: Aegis2 add-back
entries.issue: Boolean correctness training may not teach question-dependent polarity.
entries.hypothesis: True=unsafe safety judgments may broaden Boolean transfer.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Add 250 Aegis2 decisions, preserving source labels.
entries.outcome: 60.1975%, -0.7306 pp; targeted Boolean mean declines 4.25 pp; not advanced.

entries.title: CivilComments add-back
entries.issue: Boolean transfer may benefit from a second non-correctness domain.
entries.hypothesis: Toxicity supervision may improve polarity generalization.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Add 250 CivilComments decisions; retain the native class imbalance.
entries.outcome: 61.4523%, +0.5242 pp; targeted mean +0.75 pp; neither advance threshold passes.

entries.title: SNLI and MultiNLI add-back
entries.issue: ContractNLI nearly omits Contradiction.
entries.hypothesis: Cross-domain three-way NLI may restore contradiction predictions.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Add 250 decisions from the two NLI sources.
entries.outcome: 61.0467%, +0.1186 pp; ContractNLI unchanged and Contradiction still absent; not advanced.

entries.title: MASSIVE add-back
entries.issue: Circa favors a dominant option; many-option training coverage was reduced.
entries.hypothesis: Intent classification may improve competing-option discrimination.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Add 250 MASSIVE decisions with the same counts, updates and heldouts.
entries.outcome: 62.0386%, +1.1105 pp; Circa +6.5 pp. Both screen criteria pass, but the conditional interval includes zero; new-seed confirmation required.

entries.title: BANKING77 add-back
entries.issue: The same many-option hypothesis might transfer from banking intents.
entries.hypothesis: More competing intent options may reduce option bias.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Add 250 BANKING77 decisions independently of MASSIVE.
entries.outcome: 60.3814%, -0.5467 pp; Circa -4.5 pp; not advanced.

entries.title: Equal-volume source control
entries.issue: A larger training set or extra updates could masquerade as a useful restored source.
entries.hypothesis: Fresh examples from existing domains provide a fair volume control.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Add 250 unused existing-source decisions; match 6,512 train, 809 dev, 857 calibration, 510 updates and seed.
entries.outcome: Completed control: 60.9281%. This is the comparator for all six source screens.

entries.title: RuleTaker instruction repair
entries.issue: The normalized RuleTaker question omitted native closed-world semantics.
entries.hypothesis: Making negation-as-failure explicit may repair a supervision/instruction mismatch.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Confirmed instruction omission: state the closed-world rule explicitly while retaining the exact 250 records, native labels and training windows; extract fresh features for changed requests.
entries.outcome: Completed: 60.5166%, -0.4177 pp versus original RuleTaker. TabFact +0.5 pp; both thresholds fail. The omission was real, but is not established as the cause of benchmark regressions.

entries.title: Frozen pretrained answer readout
entries.issue: Small supervised heads transfer poorly and collapse on some suites.
entries.hypothesis: The frozen backbone may already know the decisions better than the trained head.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Use pretrained answer-letter output rows, no head training, and one calibration-only temperature.
entries.outcome: Completed: 77.1359% composite, 82.4475% dev; stronger than the trained heads. This does not prove which training source caused their failures.

entries.title: Single-token answer codes
entries.issue: Numeric answer codes become multiple tokens for larger option sets.
entries.hypothesis: Uppercase letters can cover all panel options with one token each.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Confirmed tokenizer issue: replace numeric codes with A–Z; normalize tokenizer outputs to flat IDs; check every encoded input.
entries.outcome: Implemented before candidate accuracy measurement; full input/tokenizer checks passed.

entries.title: Boolean intercept calibration
entries.issue: Native Boolean predictions may have a transferable True/False offset.
entries.hypothesis: A single calibration-fitted intercept may improve accuracy.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Fit a fixed-grid intercept on 137 permitted Boolean calibration decisions; require the preregistered overall dev gain.
entries.outcome: Bias +0.875 improves Boolean dev accuracy, but overall gain is only +0.9889 pp, below +1 pp. Rejected; no candidate test evaluation or threshold relaxation.

entries.title: Reverse option order probability pool
entries.issue: Answer-letter or display position may influence decisions.
entries.hypothesis: Pooling native and reversed displays may reduce position sensitivity.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Align semantic option IDs and average the two uncalibrated probability vectors equally; fit global T on calibration only. Position sensitivity is a proposed mechanism.
entries.outcome: Completed and promoted: 79.4905% versus 77.1359%, +2.3546 pp; dev 84.3016%. TabFact +10 pp and RAGTruth +4.5 pp. Current verified best; Jev target 85.82% remains unmet.

entries.title: Equal trained-head and pretrained mixture
entries.issue: Two agents might have complementary errors.
entries.hypothesis: A fixed equal mixture may beat the stronger individual model.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Mix cached E5 and pretrained probabilities equally; fit a separate calibration-only T after the fixed dev gate.
entries.outcome: Dev gate passes, but test is 75.2376%, below native 77.1359%. Rejected. Higher dev accuracy did not guarantee transfer.

entries.title: Bounded native thinking
entries.issue: Direct readout may omit useful reasoning.
entries.hypothesis: A fixed short scratchpad may improve evidence and reasoning decisions.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Enable native thinking with 128 tokens; keep answer probabilities from the frozen readout. Template overhead required a capacity-only amendment; original input content was preserved. Budget calibration/dev and test separately with unchanged safety factors and accuracy gates.
entries.outcome: GPU smoke capacity passed at about 64.2 GB peak. Cold/warm measurements retained. Calibration completed (857/857); dev inference is running (568/809 observed 2026-10-15T17:44:25.015614+00:00). No completed dev accuracy or thinking test result yet.

entries.title: Shortest-example few-shot selection
entries.issue: A small fixed example set might teach polarity and entailment cheaply.
entries.hypothesis: Seven short demonstrations may improve frozen-model decisions.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Select the shortest approved training record in each of seven source/label cells. Semantic audit found context-free Aegis prompts and questionable NLI inferences.
entries.outcome: Rejected before any model inference. Original examples and CPU evidence preserved; native labels were not silently corrected.

entries.title: Audited seven-example prompt
entries.issue: The shortest-only selection contained ambiguous teaching examples.
entries.hypothesis: Clear self-contained demonstrations may teach the intended distinctions.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Lock seven original training examples using explicit semantic quality criteria and audit reasons; preserve source labels and query semantics.
entries.outcome: Prepared, not GPU-tested. Exact membership and all 3,777 input fingerprints passed; 1,034 added tokens, maximum final prompt 9,203. Ten helper/evaluator tests and the next resident-service CPU checks passed. GPU smoke and accuracy trial pending.

entries.title: Selective thinking on option-order disagreement
entries.issue: Full thinking is expensive and may damage already-correct pooled decisions.
entries.hypothesis: Order disagreement may identify decisions that benefit from reasoning.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Preregistered before thinking accuracy: use the pool when semantic argmax agrees; otherwise use fixed128 thinking. No fitted routing threshold or suite routing.
entries.outcome: Prepared only: routes 203/857 calibration and 180/809 dev decisions. Fourteen combined CPU checks include synthetic full scoring. Actual selective dev accuracy awaits complete thinking outputs; subset-only GPU path still pending if needed.

entries.title: Optimized kernels and matched rebaseline
entries.issue: Frozen-backbone iterations were slow; optimized kernels might change numerics.
entries.hypothesis: Optimized convolution and linear-attention kernels may reduce iteration time.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Measure combined and isolated kernels on matched inputs. Confirmed BF16 numerical drift means fresh matched caches and controls, rather than claiming equivalence.
entries.outcome: Combined speedup 1.55–1.57×, 64/64 sampled decisions agree, but strict numeric parity fails (maximum probability difference about 0.0438). Conv-only 1.04–1.05×, 62/64 agreement; FLA-only 1.43–1.45×, 64/64. Adopted as a new numerical regime, not a proven quality improvement.

entries.title: Warm-worker reuse
entries.issue: Separate short-lived workers repeatedly loaded weights and rebuilt runtime state.
entries.hypothesis: Keeping one backbone and tokenizer resident removes repeated setup.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Confirmed lifecycle overhead: one A100 worker, persistent weight volume, one in-memory pool, no blind retries, five-minute keepalive and reservation-bounded idle expiry.
entries.outcome: GPU reuse proof passed. Current thinking smokes and inference use the same worker with one backbone load. Most repeated weight progress bars were volume-to-GPU reads rather than fresh Hub downloads.

entries.title: Cache composition and union filtering
entries.issue: Repeated feature extraction and copied add-backs waste setup time.
entries.hypothesis: Exact parent reuse and extraction of the union once can preserve inputs while saving work.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Validate parent manifests, request hashes, labels and lexical rows; compose or filter only selected source records. Extract changed RuleTaker requests afresh.
entries.outcome: CPU composition contracts passed. Real source union was reused across the six screens; repaired RuleTaker used fresh changed-request features. No model-quality claim for caching itself.

entries.title: Interrupted E4 cache recovery
entries.issue: Preemption and strict cache-identity guards blocked reuse of 7,232 already-extracted records.
entries.hypothesis: Verified shards can be resumed without changing the scientific condition.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Confirmed replay/directory and metadata issues: preserve attempts; distinguish physical GPU UUID from computational identity; explicitly migrate only missing native-attention metadata; require first/last live feature parity and every shard checksum.
entries.outcome: Recovery completed and E4 finished. The migration did not authorize arbitrary backend/model differences or mixing partial scientific results.

entries.title: Identical-seed source controls diverged
entries.issue: Same-seed runs differed enough to undermine one-point source claims.
entries.hypothesis: Fused attention backward nondeterminism may amplify during BF16 head training.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Compare real 32-step replicas and autograd operations; use math SDPA only for the trainable head, then repeat two full 510-step controls. The exact individual nondeterministic operation is not conclusively isolated.
entries.outcome: Auto replicas diverged; math replicas matched. Two complete math controls exactly match selected weights, all 510 updates, dev/cal artifacts, T and all 2,111 semantic responses; both 60.9281%. Same-worker/same-seed proof only. Short math probe throughput was about 15.6% lower.

entries.title: Paired reporting and collapse diagnostics
entries.issue: A composite score can hide class collapse or sampling noise.
entries.hypothesis: Paired group comparisons and per-class recall clarify gains and failures.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Rescore exported predictions, retain the fixed denominator, report suite/class distributions and paired native-group bootstrap intervals.
entries.outcome: Implemented for completed contrasts. Intervals are conditional on reused samples and omit seed/method-selection uncertainty; no independent-confirmation claim.

entries.title: Boolean label-matched controls
entries.issue: An add-back gain might come from class proportions rather than source content.
entries.hypothesis: A matched MultiRC addition can isolate class/type exposure.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Prepare 250-record controls matching RuleTaker, Aegis2 or CivilComments label counts; run only if a preregistered Boolean screen trigger passes.
entries.outcome: Prepared and CPU-validated, not GPU-run. None of the Boolean source screens met its trigger.

entries.title: Polarity diagnostic
entries.issue: Improved Boolean accuracy could merely shift the preferred class.
entries.hypothesis: Correct/incorrect paraphrase pairs test sensitivity to question polarity.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Prepare 94 permitted dev pairs (188 requests), no fitting. Audit old runner paths and restore the saved math head backend before execution.
entries.outcome: Prepared only; old runner needs adaptation to completed math attempts. No polarity model result claimed.

entries.title: ANLI Boolean views
entries.issue: MultiRC is the sole explicit v3 Boolean source.
entries.hypothesis: Explicit Boolean entailment views may transfer beyond replaying the same choices.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Prepare matched human-labelled ANLI Boolean views and choice-replay controls; retain original allowed source groups.
entries.outcome: Prepared and validated, not GPU-run.

entries.title: Second-round source candidates
entries.issue: Sentiment, evidence decisions, narratives, causality and ordinal rubric coverage remain possible gaps.
entries.hypothesis: Each restored supervision type may improve its prespecified transfer diagnostic.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Prepare separate 250-decision SST2, PubMedQA, MCScript2+MCTest, WIQA and HelpSteer2 ordinal conditions. PubMedQA has 229 Yes/21 No/zero Maybe; it does not positively teach Maybe.
entries.outcome: Preparation and tokenizer checks only, no GPU results. GSM8K was withheld after a label-independent distractor heuristic solved the proposed constructed examples; no misleading ablation run was launched.

entries.title: New-seed confirmation
entries.issue: E5 and MASSIVE gains could depend on one initialization/order.
entries.hypothesis: Matched new seeds may reproduce the observed improvements.
entries.root_cause_or_targeted_fix: Prepare paired seeds 20261015/20261016, fixing original data splits and recipes. MASSIVE requires a positive effect in each new seed and at least +1 pp mean; original screen is excluded from that confirmation mean.
entries.outcome: Configs and CPU checks prepared; no new-seed GPU results yet. E5 and MASSIVE remain exploratory.
